hooks.command: case "$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')" in *.rs) jq -nc --arg c "Rust here has wasm32 and reuse constraints that a generic Rust reviewer will miss. This fires alongside the edit rather than before it, so if you have not read .agents/skills/rust-conventions/SKILL.md this session, read it now and re-check the edit you just made against it." '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:$c}}' ;; esac
